content:
Currently trying to state a matrix multiplication bound, but can't find clean implementations of the above in Mathlib.

The frobenius inner product of matrices seems to have been added here, but is only defined for square matrices.

Singular values are defined for Linear maps but not for matrices directly, and SVD seems to be missing.

Should I be writing my own definitions for all three of these? These are pretty standard matrix algebra properties so I'd be surprised if mathlib doesn't have them at all.
Niels Voss is working on SVD in #Is there code for X? > Singular Value Decomposition, and indeed #33731 has been merged recently

Timothe Kasriel said:

Should I be writing my own definitions for all three of these?

Are we talking in Mathlib or in a personal project?

This is for a class project. I do believe the idea would be to add the proofs to CSLib, but I am not sure whether that will actually happen. In any case if mathlib supports any of these I would much prefer using the existing mathlib structure just in case.
I found the Frobenius norm for matrices docs#Matrix.frobenius_norm_def, so maybe the inner-product is easy to add along those lines

Hi, the SVD in mathlib won't be done that soon because we are trying to figure out how to handle the existence of multiple singular value decompositions in a principled way. The current plan is to use a partial flag. But this means that there might be space for a more "standard" SVD while we wait for this.
